Keeping business operations organized so opportunities don’t slip through the cracks.

I help businesses stay organized by managing administrative tasks, coordinating schedules, keeping track of leads, and supporting consistent follow-ups. From inbox management to lead tracking, I keep information organized and tasks moving.

View my workContact me
Available for remote opportunities

Practical support. Clear processes. Organized work.

Emails need responses, appointments need managing, records need updating and potential customers need follow-up. When these tasks are scattered across tools or handled without a clear process, things get overlooked. I provide remote administrative and operational support to bring structure to them.

With training in Hybrid Virtual Operations, a background in Computer Engineering, and practical projects in inbox management, calendar management and lead tracking, I’m building my career around helping businesses manage their work more effectively.

About me

I’m a Certified Hybrid Operator with a background in Computer Engineering and training in virtual assistance, administrative operations, CRM fundamentals, project management and appointment setting.

An email gets buried. An appointment is overlooked. A potential customer isn’t followed up because the last conversation wasn’t recorded. These are the problems I want to help businesses address, through careful record-keeping, clear written communication and consistent follow-through.

I’m building a career in remote virtual assistance and business operations support, with a particular interest in administrative organization, lead management and client follow-up.

How I approach my work

Organization

Clear records and structured information that is easy to find.

Attention to detail

Accuracy with schedules, contact information and business records.

Consistency

Keeping information updated so outstanding actions aren’t forgotten.

Clear communication

Willingness to learn

Services

Remote support for administrative tasks, information management, scheduling, lead tracking and written communication. Responsibilities can be tailored to your business and the tools you use.

Email and Inbox Management

Organize your inbox so important messages and open conversations are easy to find.

  • Labels, folders and filters
  • Flagging emails that need attention
  • Tracking outstanding replies
  • Routine correspondence on your instructions

Calendar Management and Scheduling

Keep appointments current, conflict free and clear across time zones.

  • Adding and updating events
  • Checking for conflicts
  • Time zone coordination
  • Reminders and clear event titles

Lead Management and Follow-Up

Know who was contacted, what was said and when the next follow-up is due.

  • Lead records in sheets or supported CRMs
  • Status, priority and follow-up dates
  • Interaction history and notes
  • Follow-up messages on your instructions

Appointment Setting Support

The administrative side of getting appointments booked and confirmed.

  • Coordinating dates and times
  • Checking availability
  • Written confirmations
  • Tracking pending requests

General Administrative Support

Careful handling of the everyday records that keep a business moving.

  • Data entry and record updates
  • Spreadsheet and file organization
  • Task trackers
  • Simple reports and summaries

Client Communication and Coordination

Organized written communication and no conversation left waiting.

  • Drafting routine emails
  • Replies using approved information
  • Communication records
  • Preparing follow-ups

Before starting, I confirm what needs to be done, the expected outcome, the deadline and the procedures to follow. Then I organize the work, complete it carefully, update the records and report progress.

Virtual assistance and email management

Inbox management and email organization

A high-volume inbox is hard to navigate. This exercise organized one using labels and filters to create a clearer email management structure.

Virtual assistance and calendar management

Calendar management and scheduling

95%76 out of 80 in the assessment

This result reflects my performance in the training exercise, not a client engagement.

Lead management, spreadsheet organization, client acquisition support

Real estate lead management and follow-up system

A spreadsheet system that keeps lead details, interaction history and follow-up tasks in one place, so it is clear which leads need attention and what happens next.

What’s inside: a Lead Tracker, a Dashboard with totals and overdue follow-ups, an Interaction Log, a How to Use guide and sample follow-up Message Examples.

  • Lead status categories
  • Hot, warm and cold classifications
  • High, medium and low priority
  • Follow-up date tracking
  • Overdue follow-up indicators
  • Dropdown menus for consistent entry
  • Conditional formatting
  • Dashboard summaries and charts

How I work

  1. Understand the task

    Responsibility, expected outcome, deadline and instructions.

  2. Organize the work

    The information, tools and steps required.

  3. Carry out the task

    Careful work with attention to accuracy and detail.

  4. Keep information updated

    Records, trackers and schedules stay useful.

  5. Communicate progress

    Updates, flagged issues and questions when something is unclear.

  6. Review and follow through

    Check the work is done and name any next steps.
